editorial.blurb: A cherished family-owned gem in Lakeview serving authentic Mexican food with care and passion, where every visit reveals something delicious worth trying.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the house-made tres leches cake—they bake it multiple times weekly because it sells out, and definitely bring your own wine since they're BYOB; the small space is cozy but can fit groups of up to 6 if you call ahead.
